AccountR15LegalConsent.description: Exact current translated legal versions. Required when the resolved site's legal policy is enabled; ageConfirmed must be true when a minimum age is configured. Omitted optional telemetry consent never grants collection.

AccountR15PendingBinding.description: Provider identity has been verified but the binding mutation is pending. This view contains no provider tokens or OAuth state. Complete the exact attempt from its initiating browser/setup context.

features.description: Registered RegionalFeature code to enabled flag; unknown service codes are rejected on writes.

AccountR15RegionalPolicy.description: Omitted region/service inherits enabled. Essential account services cannot be disabled. No unknown region or null flag is accepted.

AppsContractDecision.description: Approval requires matching two-digit number and userVerified=true; signed denial does not.

AppsContractNativeAdminAction.description: One of seven named actions, sorted by id. path is the full canonical account endpoint; detail/photo companions share its action. available reports whether the equivalent browser capability is ported to this site.

AppsContractNativeAdminCapabilities.description: Catalog is the live policy/consented scope/current staff permission intersection; it can be empty.

policyRevision.description: 0 before first save; every successful write increments the revision

grantToken.description: Returned once; only its SHA-256 is retained. Send in X-Native-Admin-Grant together with native access proof.

AppsContractNativeAdminGrantExport.description: Explicit exportNativeAdminGrants projection. No bearer/hash, confirming browser session, siteId or userId is serialized; revokedAt omitted until revoked.

actions.description: Stored sorted action IDs separated by spaces; the export uses a string, not the issuance array

policyRevision.description: 0 before first save; every successful write increments the revision

AppsContractNativeAdminGrantInput.description: Every selected action must already be enabled by policy, consented to this family and currently allowed for the staff actor; no partial grant is issued.

nativeSessionId.description: Native caller may omit for its current family; a normal browser must identify an owned valid family. Another family is forbidden for a native caller.

AppsContractNativeAdminRealNameListRecor.description: Same serialized record fields as detail, with masked idCardNumber and available username/nickname/uid enrichment. Unmasked detail and photo access require reviews.realname.inspect.

extra.description: Document-registry extra fields; no private photo file identifiers

idCardNumber.description: Masked by validate.MaskIDCard; never the full number on this list route

AppsContractNativeAdminRealNameRecord.description: Complete model.RealNameRecord JSON for an authorized reviewer. Includes document metadata, diagnostic fields and sorted photo slot names; raw ExtraJSON/PhotosJSON are hidden. timex timestamps use local YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.

extra.description: Document-registry extra fields; no private photo file identifiers

idCardNumber.description: Full unmasked document number on the separately authorized detail operation

reason.description: At most 1000 UTF-8 bytes before trimming; nonblank required on rejection

AppsContractNativeAdminServer.description: nativeAdminServerView: display/status/count fields only, including null lastHeartbeat when absent. List populates role counts; detail/status responses can retain zero derived counts. No API keys or key prefixes.

message.description: At most 255 UTF-8 bytes before trimming. Nonblank replaces the message; blank clears it in maintenance, otherwise preserves it.

AppsContractNativeAdminUser.description: nativeAdminUserView: only these eight projected display/status fields. No contacts, role assignments, credentials or full admin user bundle.

status.description: 0 normal, 1 frozen; shared-site membership projection applies

AppsContractNativeBrowserApproval.description: Public Approval fields for native_browser/login_restricted. userId is 0 before native discovery. deviceId/consumedAt are omitted until set. Number, poll/browser hashes, failed-attempt count and factor/ceremony state are never returned here.

scope.description: Space-separated subset of native.account.read and native.account.write; no security/admin/login-approval scope is inherited

AppsContractNativeBrowserDecisionInput.description: Flat Decision fields plus consent. Approval requires consent=true, userVerified=true and the matching number; a signed denial needs none of those. userVerified is local confirmation, not fresh browser MFA evidence.

number.description: Matching two-digit browser number for approval; denial may omit it

signature.description: Unpadded base64url Ed25519 DecisionMessage signature; separate from the outer request-proof signature

AppsContractNativeBrowserIntentExport.description: User-filtered NativeBrowserIntent JSON, newest id first. approvedAt omitted until approved. No user/site/family ID, policy revision, factor time, MFA attempt count, passkey ceremony ID or Approval secrets.

scope.description: Space-separated subset of native.account.read and native.account.write; no security/admin/login-approval scope is inherited

AppsContractNativeBrowserLogin.description: Restricted successful LoginResult projection only. No generic challenge, setup token, trustedDevice or refresh token. Only a single approved, unexpired, bound intent can be consumed. The resulting brs_ opaque bearer is a restricted browser credential, not an ordinary session JWT; every later request also requires its new HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict sakura_restricted_browser cookie at /api. It inherits only the exact native.account.read/write snapshot, has isAdmin=false and cannot authorize credential enrollment, admin routes, OAuth/SSO, native grants or further QR approvals. Lifetime is at most 30 minutes, capped by the native family, live source backing session and login policy, with no refresh/sliding extension. Future requests recheck its own core backing session, the source family's explicit revocation/expiry, current OAuth consent, device/app and browser policy revision. Session-cap eviction of the old native backing alone does not revoke the already consumed independent browser delegation; its own logout/session revocation still applies.

AppsContractNativeBrowserPasskeyBegin.description: Pass options.publicKey to navigator.credentials.get after binary conversion. This response has no sessionId or generic login continuation.

pollToken.description: Independent secret from the same start response; must match together with the original HttpOnly sakura_native_qr cookie

AppsContractNativeBrowserPasskeyFinish.description: Records fresh factor proof only on this intent for at most five minutes and no longer than intent validity. Call the original poll endpoint to finish; no session token is returned here.

AppsContractNativeBrowserPasskeyFinishIn.description: credential is the browser assertion JSON object, not a JSON string; its serialized RawMessage is limited to 65536 bytes. The server selects the hidden ceremony ID from this bound intent.

pollToken.description: Independent secret from the same start response; must match together with the original HttpOnly sakura_native_qr cookie

AppsContractNativeBrowserPasskeyOptions.description: BeginPasskeyLogin assertion options only: options.publicKey includes challenge/RP/timeout and userVerification=required. The generic ceremony sessionId remains stored server-side on the intent and is not returned.

extensions.description: Optional WebAuthn extension inputs from the library.

AppsContractNativeError.description: HTTP 200 business/authentication error envelope; no success data. Common codes: 1, 400, 401, 403, 409, 4284, 4287.

AppsContractNativeInput.description: deviceId omitted/empty creates a binding; existing ID <=64 bytes must belong to this account/app with the same key. Metadata limits are UTF-8 bytes.

AppsContractNativeTokens.description: Bearer access lifetime <=600 seconds. Refresh token begins nsr_ and is empty without offline_access. Family lifetime 30 days with offline_access, otherwise 10 minutes.

AppsContractPushCredential.description: No private credential returned; publicKey is the Web Push VAPID public key only.

AppsContractPushInput.description: Consent must be true. Exact JSON request body <=16384 bytes.

AppsContractPushJob.description: Delivery status only; never raw device token, target, provider credentials or private notification context.

AppsContractPushTarget.description: FCM: token 20..4096 bytes without whitespace. APNs: even-length 64..200 hex characters. Web Push: HTTPS public endpoint <=4096 bytes on port 443; host allowlist fcm.googleapis.com, updates.push.services.mozilla.com, push.services.mozilla.com, web.push.apple.com or *.notify.windows.com. P-256 public key and 16-byte auth secret as unpadded base64url; no token. Token-only providers must omit endpoint/p256dh/auth.

AppsContractSettings.description: All effective apps.* settings, including push/native settings; values remain strings. Grace days 0..365; payment policy off/always/above_amount; threshold JSON has <=32 nonnegative amounts keyed by 3-character currency; exempt roles JSON <=4096 bytes; link templates JSON <=8192 bytes, <=12 entries, each contains {value} and no colon, leading slash, backslash or CR/LF. Scheme 2..64 characters and safe; download/universal links empty or HTTPS.

AppsContractWebPush.description: VAPID P-256 32-byte private key encoded base64url; mailto or HTTPS subject.

AppsR15ActionRequest.description: 40 KiB wrapper; input is a strict <=32 KiB exact-action DTO. Login factors have no generic start/preparation endpoint. Client cannot submit a subject, victim user or arbitrary method/path.

AppsR15ActionStarted.description: Only required:false when no approval is needed; required:true adds request, pollToken, number, deepLink and exact safe context.

context.description: Safe human-readable exact-action context; secrets/digests not returned.

AppsR15ConfigSchema.description: Bounded local JSON Schema subset. Unknown keywords including $ref are rejected; never fetches external schemas.

AppsR15DevicePolicyState.description: Missing rooted/jailbroken reports are JSON null. Device signature proves report source, not hardware integrity.

message.description: Nonblank valid UTF-8, <=8000 bytes before scrubbing.

AppsR15FirstPartyApproval.description: Safe presentation only. Never returns private login approval ID/proof, browser session JWT, setup grant or challengeId. Enrollment number has 6 digits; approval number has 2.

AppsR15FirstPartyCodeSent.description: Debug code is always stripped from this native response.

flowToken.description: Five-minute device-bound flow capability. Only in JSON, never Authorization or a URL.

AppsR15FirstPartyPolicyInput.description: Strict application/json. Enabling requires nonempty methods and scopes, including native.account.read; disabling allows omitted/empty/null lists. Revision defaults 0 before first policy, otherwise must match.

AppsR15HostInventory.description: Explicit host projection. Linux kernel readers; Windows/macOS bounded native collectors with unavailable reasons; platform-specific fields may be absent/null. Hostname only when configured. No provider credentials or arbitrary environment variables.

AppsR15JSONValue.description: JSON value only where the source explicitly uses map[string]any or a bounded JSON-schema value; not a substitute for a known DTO.

messages.description: Merged native locale tree, including registered provider/admin text overrides.

grantToken.description: Returned once; only its SHA-256 is retained. Send in X-Native-Admin-Grant together with native access proof.

AppsR15NotificationCampaign.description: title and body are stored multilingual JSON strings, not decoded maps.

remoteConfig.description: Selected public configuration only; no targeting tree, tags, saved segments or editor authority.

AppsR15ProbeInventory.description: Private inventory; no hostnames, IP addresses or environment variables. <=64 disks/interfaces, <=32 temperatures, <=256 core metrics.

unavailable.description: Metric group to bounded unavailable reason.

AppsR15ProbeReport.description: protocol.Sample. Version 0/omitted is legacy and forbids nonempty available/inventory. Version 2 requires every availability group. Unavailable numeric metrics are null on probe serialization; unknown is never a fabricated zero observation.

AppsR15ProbeResult.description: Detail restricted to HTTP <100..599>, connected/resolved/verified, or failed/blocked/timeout/unsupported. No arbitrary target response text. Latency <=(timeoutSec+1)*1000.

AppsR15RealtimeServerFrame.description: Invalidation metadata only; fetch authorized HTTP resources for content. No message body, matching number, proof or bearer token in events.

downloadUrl.description: Empty for a draft or HTTPS artifact URL; installer bytes are not uploaded here.

remoteConfig.description: Public JSON configuration snapshot, <=16 KiB; no credentials.

AppsR15ReleaseInput.description: 64 KiB strict JSON. Create revision=0; edit must match stored revision; published snapshots immutable.

downloadUrl.description: Empty for a draft or HTTPS artifact URL; installer bytes are not uploaded here.

remoteConfig.description: Public JSON configuration snapshot, <=16 KiB; no credentials.

AppsR15SupportDetail.description: Payload omitted after redaction. SQL/private-file identifiers, device keys and site routing internals never returned.

AuthR15AccountActionError.description: Mandatory account completion; normal data is {actionRequired:true,route:<canonical internal account page>}. A rejected unsafe recovery route omits data and never becomes an external redirect. HTTP status remains 200. Source: service/account_gate_oauth.go.

AuthR15BusinessError.description: Application error envelope, normally HTTP 200. Exact possible codes and recovery are specified per operation; message is localized. No success payload is returned.

AuthR15ClientJWKS.description: Bounded public key set for RS256/ES256 private_key_jwt authentication. Duplicate kid and private key material are rejected.

AuthR15DelegationPolicy.description: Global policy. Defaults: sensitive approval disabled, maximum lifetime 168 hours. Later changes do not alter existing expiries or auto-activate pending grants.

AuthR15Discovery.description: Current host/site issuer metadata. Registration endpoint appears only while DCR is enabled. Delivery/logout hooks add their actual implemented fields. No implicit/hybrid grants, address scope, claims parameter or check_session_iframe is advertised.

AuthR15EventSchema.description: Actual registered event JSON Schema, not an event payload. Registry requires a closed object with typed fields and a valid secret-free sample.

AuthR15JSONValue.description: JSON value in registered claim mappings or JSON Schema documents; this extension is intentionally heterogeneous.

AuthR15Key.description: apikeys.View. Contains public prefix and control/counter metadata only; no token, verifier, secret hash or HMAC key. canManage denotes ownership, independently of the key's current status. Minute/day counters reset on UTC bucket boundaries.

AuthR15KeyActivity.description: Admission and lifecycle metadata only. accepted means credential admission, not downstream business success. No bodies, query strings, token verifiers or credentials.

AuthR15KeyInput.description: Create or full policy replacement. One nonempty code/password is required and verified. Personal keys accept only account:* scopes; service keys remain bounded by their creator. No wildcards. Update cannot change kind or reactivate revoked/expired/retired keys.

allowedIps.description: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDRs, normalized; empty removes IP restrictions.

allowedOrigins.description: Exact normalized HTTP(S) origins; no wildcards, userinfo or non-root path. A nonempty list rejects missing Origin.

code.description: Current TOTP/recovery code when two-factor authentication is enabled.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339; strictly more than one minute from now, at most 366 days.

password.description: Current password confirmation for accounts without TOTP.

token.description: The only plaintext copy of the newly issued lk_v1_ token; retain it securely. Never appears in reads/history/exports.

AuthR15KeyRotate.description: Fresh password/TOTP/recovery confirmation is required. 0 retires the old key immediately; overlap is bounded by its original expiry.

AuthR15MyAppInput.description: Legacy fields are full replacements; new pointer fields omitted/null preserve stored settings. Type derives public/grants: web confidential, SPA/native public, service machine grant. Non-service apps need redirects and openid is added; service strips openid/offline_access. If scopeJustifications is supplied, every requested non-openid scope needs a nonempty reason. Policy/ToS are HTTPS, with explicit localhost HTTP development exception.

oneOf.description: JSON-encoded public JWKS, at most 65536 bytes; not an inline object in this API.

AuthR15MyAppSaved.description: clientSecret is nonempty only when a shared secret was newly issued. Public and private_key_jwt clients receive an empty string.

AuthR15OAuthError.description: RFC OAuth error JSON with a meaningful HTTP status; not an application {code,message,data} envelope.

AuthR15OIDCPolicy.description: String-valued settings map. Boolean values are true/false strings; grants are comma-separated (empty closes all grants). Access/ID maxima 60..86400 sec, refresh values 60..31536000 sec, secret overlap 0..86400 sec. PUT rejects any unknown key and updates only supplied keys.

AuthR15OperatorRange.description: The operator's own delegation ceiling: whether they are the super administrator, the data scope they may delegate within, the permission keys they currently hold and the roles they may hand out. `held` and `grantableRoles` are never null (empty arrays instead), and a `users:all` scope reports the current maximum trust level.

AuthR15PermissionAudit.description: Atomic before/after diffs are JSON strings; no mutable grant payload is exposed.

scope.description: Stored JSON-encoded RoleScope; effectiveScope is the parsed, currently bounded object.

AuthR15PermissionGrantInput.description: Finite deadline within global lifetime maximum. Scope servers must exist; canGrantRoles must be empty. Each key must be declared, non-super-only and currently grantable by the issuer.

AuthR15PermissionSource.description: Physical role/site-staff role/temporary grant/super/restricted-credential explanation. Optional IDs and deadlines are omitted when inapplicable.

AuthR15PlaygroundOAuthError.description: HTTP 400 sanitized protocol error from developerFailure. message and data.oauthError contain the standard code only.

AuthR15PlaygroundTokenInput.description: Authorization code uses the saved state/callback/nonce/S256 and same owner; refresh token belongs to that owner/client. Machine grant requires confidential client and no state/code/refreshToken. Client credentials remain transient and follow registered method.

AuthR15ProtocolErrorRecord.description: Allowlisted endpoint and standard error code only; never raw protocol descriptions, request payloads or credentials.

AuthR15PublicJWK.description: Public RSA or EC verification key. RSA uses n/e, EC uses crv=P-256 and x/y. Private d/p/q/dp/dq/qi or symmetric k material is rejected by client JWKS validation.

AuthR15RegistrationInput.description: RFC metadata JSON, UTF-8, at most 96 KiB. Default name OIDC application, type web, auth client_secret_basic and authorization_code grant. HTTPS metadata links; code flows require exact redirects and code response type. New registration forbids client_id/client_secret. PUT requires matching client_id and cannot set a new secret; omitted metadata resets to defaults.

AuthR15RegistrationResponse.description: Issued-at/expiry values are Unix seconds. Shared client_secret is returned only on initial issue or credential-mode transition; GET cannot recover it. Every PUT rotates registration_access_token.

AuthR15SSOSettingsInput.description: enabled/cookieDomain are full replacement (omitted false/empty). Optional ticketTtl/defaultHeaders preserve stored values when omitted/null. Global ticket TTL defaults to 60 seconds.

AuthR15SSOTicketResult.description: Direct protocol JSON. authTime and expiresAt are Unix seconds. sessionId is an opaque target-session SID, never an account credential. RP must enforce expiresAt and validate issuer/audience; logoutSupported signals durable callback participation for this redemption.

claims.description: App-published identity aliases; values are strings. Verified email only; groups are comma-separated role codes.

AuthR15TokenResponse.description: OAuth token JSON. Refresh token is rotating and only issued for allowed offline access. ID token exists only for user authorization with openid; may be signed then encrypted per delivery policy. Machine grants have no user identity.

AuthR15UserInfo.description: Only granted-scope and privacy-permitted claims are released. Delivery/SSO claim maps may rename or omit permitted identity attributes; sub is preserved and pairwise clients do not receive global uid/username. Dynamic registered claim values are JSON.

AuthR15WebhookDelivery.description: Wire payload is a JSON string when valid and at most 20 KiB. Quarantined rows suppress response/payload; sampleEvent is omitted for non-test deliveries. No subject/owner IDs or claim leases.

AuthR15WebhookEndpoint.description: Explicit owner-safe projection. Contains no secret, owner ID, extra headers, encryption profile or arbitrary mapping.

AuthR15WebhookInput.description: Strict JSON object, maximum 4 KiB; unknown keys/trailing JSON rejected. Public HTTPS destination only, SSRF-checked on write and send. Owner/site/app/secret/header overrides cannot be supplied.

AuthR15WebhookIssued.description: secret is returned only when created/rotated; update omits it. Later metadata/history does not reveal the stored signing credential.

AuthR15WebhookTest.description: Any catalogue event with a registered sample may be tested; event payload is generated by the server and cannot be supplied by the caller.

scope.description: space separated; `openid` is implied

restartExit.description: exit code after a restore; the supervisor must restart the process on it

supported.description: the built-in backup works with the configured database (SQLite)

creator.description: who took a manual backup; empty for scheduled runs

code.description: code sent with scene `bind_email` / `bind_phone`

CallbackResult.description: Source service.CallbackResult: login, redirect, bound, message and bindingAttempt are omitted when empty. A bindingAttempt means provider verification succeeded, not that an identity was attached.

brokenId.description: first row that fails; omitted when ok

reason.description: `hash`: a row changed; `link`: a row before it was removed or inserted; omitted when ok

truncated.description: older rows exist beyond the checked window

trustedDeviceDays.description: Omitted when zero. Configured remembered-browser duration; zero when current policy requires fresh factor. Recovery codes are accepted by the totp flow but are not a separate methods entry.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP or one unused XXXXX-XXXXX recovery code; outer whitespace trimmed and recovery text uppercased.

rememberDevice.description: Request a separate trusted-device grant after challenge completion; the original challenge remembers the session's remember setting.

action.description: mute, ban, kick, lift, recall, approve, reject, role_owner/mod/member, gm, report_resolve/dismiss

channelId.description: 0 for site-wide admin action; positive channel ID required on viewer endpoint and for kick.

channels.description: Comma-separated positive IDs, not a JSON array.

name.description: Unique within this bot; help/gm/bind/unbind are reserved.

avatar.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes; empty, https:// URL or /uploads/ path.

webhookUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS URL, at most 500 bytes; SSRF validation rejects private/loopback destinations.

ChatContractWSClient.description: UTF-8 JSON frames, maximum 16384 bytes. First frame must be auth within 10 seconds; choose token, ticket (+ optional server), or bearer. If multiple credentials exist, token wins, then ticket, then bearer. sub replaces subscriptions; send requires a subscribed channel. Clients normally ping every 25–30 seconds; 75 seconds without inbound activity closes the connection.

Error codes match chat business errors; authentication/connection-cap failure closes the socket. hb every 30 seconds. The declared channel event constant has no current producer and is not an invented wire frame here.

Files are private for every supported entity (user/server/ticket/application/order), never public. User requiredAt accepts register/profile; other entities accept application. admins audience forbids requiredAt. Schema revision changes cannot invalidate saved values; file handles are scoped to site/entity/subject/owner/key.

Strings are never coerced to numbers. file is positive integer id <=2^53-1 belonging to same site/user/key. date YYYY-MM-DD; country uppercase ISO alpha-2; url HTTP(S) <=2048 bytes without credentials, controls or markup; multi distinct defined option strings, max 100. Non-user host fields use the host's site, entity and subject in the same transaction as the host save. Create-form staged files bind to the authenticated uploader and are claimed on creation; no foreign subject or raw storage identifier is accepted.

Each property is optional: modules compiled out, nil Export callbacks, callback panics, and nil callback results leave no key. ExportByUser arrays are newest ID first unless a custom callback documents another order; limits apply per property. Typed-nil callback results can serialize null. Known no-Export registry keys are excluded. Additional keys are only genuinely third-party registered UserData extensions; their JSON is not a substitute for the typed built-in contracts. Source: internal/service/userdata.go:userDataExport and each module's userdata registration.

FederationContractConfig.description: Fields depend on kind; /meta is authoritative for registered plugins. sso has no config. scim uses inbound options. scim_client requires baseUrl and secret.token, supports outbound options and disable/delete. http requires secret.secret (16..4096 bytes), direction defaults out, and url unless direction=in. URL/text fields are limited to 512 bytes (textarea 8192); URL fields pass SSRF validation; private networks require connectors.allow_private_network or debug mode. Omitted config fields use defaults, not previous values. Outbound responses are limited to 1 MiB; transport timeout at most 60 seconds. Retryable statuses: 408/425/429/5xx, with Retry-After capped at 24 hours.

FederationContractInbound.description: The handler uses the timestamp header, not timestamp in the body. data omitted/null becomes an empty document. created/updated/upsert all upsert; deleting an absent externalId is idempotent.

Writable profile fields only; admin accounts cannot be linked/modified. Password policy and email uniqueness/domain rules still apply.

FederationContractInboundResult.description: id/externalId when a link was involved; duplicate only for an already completed delivery; ping returns ok only.

FederationContractInstance.description: Secrets, token hashes and public endpoint key storage are never returned. loadError is optional. failed counts failed+dead; sso links counts provider bindings.

FederationContractJob.description: action includes user create/update/disable/enable/delete and inbound group_create/group_update/group_delete/ping/event. source includes hook/sync/retry/scim/http. Error is localized; never payloads or secrets.

FederationContractMapping.description: At most 64 rules per direction; unused default directions can be null. Input targets must be writable local catalogue fields; roles/status/trust are not writable.

website.description: Empty or a complete HTTPS URL, maximum 255 bytes.

FederationContractRule.description: from/to: at most 300 bytes; transform: at most 500 bytes. from: fallback sources separated by | or =literal. transform chains trim/lower/upper/bool/not/string/number/first/prefix/suffix/default/split/join/map with |. Remote paths support selectors and extension URNs.

FederationContractSave.description: POST requires a registered kind and ignores id; PUT requires id and keeps the stored kind. sso requires providerCode. New instances are disabled. null/omitted mapping retains the stored mapping; an explicit default mapping resets the override. clear lists secret fields to erase; required secrets cannot be erased.

kind.description: Built-ins: scim, scim_client, http, sso; other registered kinds are allowed.

secret.description: Only declared secret fields are read; nonempty values replace, blank/omitted values retain existing values. Maximum 4096 bytes per secret.

status.description: HTTP status encoded as a decimal string.

FederationContractScimGroup.description: Member type is User. Projection can omit displayName/members/meta. Membership changes update meta.version.

FederationContractScimGroupInput.description: externalId is truncated to 191 bytes. Member values reference this connector's SCIM user ids; duplicates collapse, unknown ids are silently skipped. Nested groups are not provisioned.

FederationContractScimPatch.description: Path supports attributes, selectors and enterprise URNs. Pathless add/replace requires an object; keys may be paths. A filtered add/replace with no match creates an element. User id/meta/groups/schema output is rebuilt by the server after the patch; editing these does not change stored identity/group membership. schemas is accepted but not enforced.

FederationContractScimSchema.description: The implementation's schema records omit the schemas member.

FederationContractScimUser.description: Stored remote document overlaid with mapped local profile. id is opaque Link.ScimID, never local user id. Top-level password is removed. Sanitized remote document persistence is capped at 16 KiB; larger documents are not retained, although mapped local updates can succeed. attributes/excludedAttributes projection can remove every named field except schemas/id; groups only appears when nonempty.

FederationContractScimUserInput.description: Case-insensitive SCIM keys; schemas is not validated. Custom remote fields can be stored and mapped. active defaults true only on create; absent update fields preserve local profile values. password follows site policy, and matched existing accounts keep their password on create.

externalId.description: Maximum 191 bytes; omitted on create generates an internal scim:<uuid> external id.

connectors.scim_rate_per_minute.description: Integer string 0..100000; default 600; 0 disables instance rate limit.

FederationContractSettingsInput.description: Partial update; values converted to strings and validated. Unknown keys ignored.

FederationContractValue.description: A JSON value in a registered connector's configurable mapping or remote extension document.

ownerId.description: self-service owner (`server-owner` module); null = managed by staff

reviewStatus.description: onboarding review; servers created by staff are approved

siteId.description: The server entity's owning site. Creation takes this from request context and ignores a supplied siteId.

whitelistMode.description: 0 off, 1 manual review, 2 auto by trust level

GamesContractArchiveUserExport.description: Account data-export hook: 30-second budget and 32 MiB serialized total; complete=false reports partial output. Export individual bindings when required.

GamesContractJSONValue.description: JSON value for a documented dynamic upstream/plugin payload; no invented fixed fields.

data.description: Upstream section JSON (at most 1 MiB), recursively sanitized and filtered by current field restrictions. Schema differs by game and section.

raw.description: Sanitized upstream index payload, recursively stripped of credentials and fields hidden by current policies.

summary.description: Localized metric label to scalar value; unsupported metrics are omitted.

GamesContractMihoyoSettings.description: Actual map[string]string settings contract. Unknown keys are ignored; supplied values validate together before saving.

mihoyo.allow_cookie.description: Boolean setting encoded as a string

mihoyo.allow_qr.description: Boolean setting encoded as a string

mihoyo.ds_salt_v1.description: Read: ******** if an override exists; empty means built-in. Write: ******** preserves, empty resets, otherwise 8..64 alphanumeric characters. Stored encrypted.

mihoyo.ds_salt_v2.description: Read: ******** if an override exists; empty means built-in. Write: ******** preserves, empty resets, otherwise 8..64 alphanumeric characters. Stored encrypted.

mihoyo.enabled.description: Boolean setting encoded as a string

mihoyo.games.description: Comma-separated allowed game_biz values; at most 24.

mihoyo.record_enabled.description: Boolean setting encoded as a string

mihoyo.record_sections.description: JSON object mapping canonical game ID to allowed section IDs.

security.rate_mihoyo_cookie_per_min.description: Integer string 0..60; per-user limits remain active.

security.rate_mihoyo_qr_start_per_min.description: Integer string 0..60; 0 disables per-IP limiting only.

GamesContractMihoyoVerify.description: The caller's parked risk challenge, or the binding's current state when none is parked. Only `pending` is always present; every other field is omitted when empty. `gt`/`challenge` are the upstream geetest widget parameters, `challengeId` is this server's single-use handle, and `message` is a localized explanation of why no challenge could be issued.

code.description: -1 denied; -2 invalid arguments; -3 not found; -4 limit; -5 upstream; -6 unknown function

settings.description: Manifest-defined setting/field key to scalar value. Unknown keys and wrong types are rejected by the respective validator.
Manifest-defined setting/field key to scalar value. Unknown keys and wrong types are rejected by the respective validator.

subtitle.description: A string is accepted as zh_CN; responses serialize a locale-to-string object.

title.description: A string is accepted as zh_CN; responses serialize a locale-to-string object.

GamesContractSDKTemplateInput.description: Origins must be exact HTTPS origins; HTTP is permitted only on loopback. No wildcards, paths or directive injection.

html.description: Nonempty UTF-8 HTML; at most 64 KiB; forbidden tags/inline event handlers/script URLs are rejected.

js.description: At most 128 KiB UTF-8; total HTML/CSS/JS at most 192 KiB.

networkType.description: as the source reports it (hosting, mobile, cable …)

region.description: area between country and province where a source has one

items.description: database or provider name

version.description: 4 or 6; 0 when the input is not an address

GeoLocationConfig.description: Collection switch (`geolocation.enabled`) and the retention window (`geolocation.retention_days`, 1-3650 days; 0 or less keeps records forever).

GeoLocationConfigBody.description: Partial update: a field that is absent keeps its stored value. An empty body simply returns the current configuration.

enabled.description: Omitted leaves the stored value untouched.

retentionDays.description: 1-3650; omitted leaves the stored value untouched.

GeoLocationPerson.description: Account summary of a record's owner; omitted when the row has no owner or the account is outside the operator's managed set.

GeoLocationReportBody.description: A browser geolocation report. Coordinates are rounded to five decimal places (about one metre) before storage. The answer never echoes a coordinate back.

accuracy.description: Metres, as reported by the browser; 0 to 100000. Rounded to one decimal place before storage.

denied.description: The visitor refused the location prompt (or it failed); no coordinates are sent in that case.

GeoLocationReportResult.description: The report was stored. Deliberately carries no coordinate, so no visitor-facing page can render a location.

GeoLocationRow.description: One stored location record. `ip` is masked (`203.0.113.*`) unless the operator is an administrator or holds `field:ip:sensitive`.

denied.description: The visitor refused the prompt; the coordinates are then 0 and meaningless.

source.description: How the coordinate was obtained; `browser` today.

user.description: Account summary; null when the row has no owner or the account is outside the operator's managed set.

available.description: at least one offline database is loaded

dir.description: where *.xdb / *.mmdb / risk lists are picked up

entries.description: address ranges of a risk list

district.description: Provider has a district field, not a guarantee of district coverage or accuracy for every IP.

keySet.description: a key is stored; the key itself is never returned

limited.description: skipped: the daily limit is reached

GeoResolutionPolicy.description: Source agreement and optional mainland/overseas routing. Unknown IP countries use both-scope sources unless unknownGlobal is explicitly enabled. Comparison ties keep the agreed parent; district confirmation can require two source families.

override.description: online answers replace the offline fields instead of only filling empty ones

GeoTestResult.description: `online` is present only for a public address with at least one provider to ask.

configValid.description: the module config parses; a bad one refuses execution for everyone

danger.description: `confirm` / `critical` need the confirm step on execute

ModulesR15ApplicationDetail.description: Form definition is the immutable submitted version; redaction removes values/files/outcome/private reason data while retaining the minimal quota receipt. Owner detail may include current eligibility. Managed-owner event actorId is masked to 0.

values.description: Field key to exact schema-typed string/number/string-array/null; no unchecked object values.

ModulesR15ApplicationSubmission.description: Masked managed-owner views set userId and reviewedBy to 0. No request IP, idempotency secret, raw snapshot or stored form JSON is exposed.

values.description: Field key to exact schema-typed string/number/string-array/null; no unchecked object values.

ModulesR15ApplicationTypeInput.description: Whitelist requires positive serverId; other types require 0. Invite uses/days apply only to invite. Fields must all be private, validated by customfields.

ModulesR15Block.description: No raw HTML type. Links are safe local paths/fragments or HTTPS; embeds require HTTPS and fixed renderer sandbox. Images are explicit URLs, never remotely fetched by backend. Block IDs are unique within a document.

ModulesR15BlockAsset.description: Deliberately public image after decode/re-encode; no binary data or original filesystem path in metadata.

ModulesR15BlockDocument.description: Canonical encoded document <=256 KiB, immutable once stored as a revision. No arbitrary CSS/script/raw HTML fields.

ModulesR15BlockPublicPage.description: Contains only server-authorized rendered blocks. Draft/internal visibility metadata is not published; a preview uses zero/empty slot metadata.

ModulesR15BlockVisibility.description: Projected roles use any-match; all current-site tags must match. Requirement evidence is evaluated on the server; browser visibility never confers authorization.

ModulesR15HomeConfig.description: Every registered widget key exactly once. Account preferences may reorder/hide; personal visibility rules are disallowed and cannot enable site-disabled widgets.

ModulesR15PointItemInput.description: membership requires a valid allowed plan; invite requires valid uses. stock=-1 is unlimited, 0 sold out; perUserLimit=0 has no lifetime quantity cap.

ModulesR15TextChange.description: value must be present. Explicit null removes a local override; missing value is rejected. Backend keys/placeholders and frontend plural forms must match the compiled catalog.

baseVersion.description: Named built-in style. Legacy v1/v2/minimal/mono import values normalize to classic; immutable saved revision content is preserved.

css.description: Restricted stylesheet <=16 KiB; see internal/modules/themepackages/FORMAT.md. No URL/font/script/asset capability.

MonitorContractAlertInput.description: nodeId must be this tenant's node; null node plus empty group targets all nodes. notifyBots and enabled omission become false; creator is notification recipient and authority is rechecked before delivery.

MonitorContractCheckInput.description: Name/target trimmed. String bounds are UTF-8 bytes. runFromNodeId must be null/omitted; probe execution unsupported. HTTP URL or TLS HTTPS URL without fragments; TCP/ping host:port; DNS name. Private destinations rejected unless globally allowed. Boolean omissions become false.

MonitorContractIncidentInput.description: Trimmed Chinese title nonblank; total UTF-8 bytes of four titles <=512 and bodies <=16000. endTime >= startTime. nodeIds input is cleared: incidents are site-wide.

MonitorContractInventory.description: Linux kernel pseudo-files only, <=1MiB each, <=64 mounts; rates unknown until second observation. On non-Linux kernel/cpuModel/openFDs/mounts/per-core/network are null. hostname null unless setting enabled.

MonitorContractNodeEdit.description: Replaces editable fields only; kind, server link and public flag are not changed here.

MonitorContractNodeInput.description: kind=game needs accessible existing gameServerId; every other kind is normalized to probe. Incoming IDs, token, lastSeen and site are ignored.

MonitorContractPublicCheck.description: Unknown/stale health is null. Day records contain actual samples only; uptime is passed/total over observed past 90 days, null without data.

MonitorContractReport.description: Raw body <=32768 bytes. Counters/load nonnegative; memory/swap/disk used <= total. CPU is clamped to 0..100. time is accepted but stored metric timestamp is server receive time; memPercent derived.

MonitorContractSettings.description: String-valued map; booleans true/false/1/0. Raw retention 1..168h (default24); 5m retention 1..90 days (30); 1h retention 1..1830 days (365); advisory report interval 5..600 seconds (30). Global settings; allow_private_checks/show_hostname super-only.

clientSecret.description: returned exactly once; empty for public clients

NotifyR15AlertReview.description: Masked IP/city-level location and session context; no raw session credential. Proof-header lookups do not echo the proof.

NotifyR15Delivery.description: NotificationOutbox's public metadata. No recipient user/address, body, proof, alert ID or lease token. accepted means accepted by a channel adapter, not displayed/read. Origin fields appear only for a linked summary.

locale.description: Normally canonical locale; test-send may retain the accepted locale alias.

NotifyR15Error.description: Localized application error; HTTP status normally remains 200. Per-operation descriptions distinguish policy, stale-write, input and storage failures.

NotifyR15LevelGrant.description: user:level. Raises level and override together, never lowers either. Shared main identities cannot be changed by a subsite; notice/event/receipt commit with the change.

level.description: At most the currently configured LevelMax and operator's scoped maximum.

NotifyR15PluginDelivery.description: No input JSON, step key, installation revision or credentials. uncertain means an ambiguous/expired external invocation; it is not blindly replayed.

NotifyR15PluginHook.description: plugin:manage. Main-site installation only, enabled explicit automation.run subscription plus approved jobs capability. Optional server requires current scope/activation/server.info capability. Queues a revision-bound action; cannot choose arbitrary sandbox hook points.

input.description: Required JSON-object text, at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes; not an inline JSON object.

NotifyR15PreferencesInput.description: Atomic locale/sharing update plus supplied event-channel preferences; omitted items preserve existing rows. Duplicate event/channel pairs are rejected. Omitted sharing disables it; mandatory security in_app/mail preferences cannot be disabled.

NotifyR15Template.description: Effective channel/locale template; fallback has revision 0 and overridden=false. legacyMailKind is present for the reused welcome/new-device mail editor.

NotifyR15TemplateInput.description: JSON maximum 72 KiB. Only named {{.Variable}} values from catalog; no functions/recursion/Code/Minutes/Scene. Security templates must retain .Body or Device+Location+Time, plus .Link for mandatory mail. Revision 0 creates an override, positive revision must match the current override.

body.description: Trimmed template; mail at most 64 KiB, other channels at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

locale.description: Supported locale or recognized locale alias; normalized to zh_CN/zh_TW/en/ja.

title.description: Trimmed template, at most 600 UTF-8 bytes.

NotifyR15UsageAccepted.description: collect=false with empty accepted means optional collection is disabled/declined. With collect=true, accepted IDs include safe retries and intentionally discarded disabled-category/module events; acknowledgement does not imply a stored business fact.

NotifyR15UsageBatch.description: At most 32 KiB of complete JSON. Empty/oversized/trailing JSON or one invalid event refuses the batch before writes.

NotifyR15UsageEvent.description: Only these struct fields participate in storage. Unknown JSON keys are ignored, never stored as arbitrary metadata. Button names and routes must match the finite catalogue. Non-duration events require durationMs absent/zero.

atMs.description: Client Unix milliseconds from at most 24 hours ago to 2 minutes ahead; server receipt time is authoritative.

route.description: Exact finite route template; never an interpolated user ID/order number/full URL/query/fragment.

NotifyR15WhitelistRemove.description: game:role:review. Role belongs to the exact target and accessible server; approved becomes banned, already banned is idempotent. Pending/rejected roles fail. Does not delete the role or audit.

tokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: Raw stored method; legacy blank resolves to none for public clients or client_secret_basic for confidential clients.

items.description: `servers.owner_modules`: modules owners may switch themselves

OnboardingInput.description: Partial update: omitted fields keep their value.

OpsContractAction.description: Each params JSON <=16384 bytes; unknown params and trailing JSON rejected. Per-action permission and target scope rechecked at execution. Tags start with Unicode letter/digit and use letters/digits/underscore/dot/space/hyphen, <=64 code points. Core notification lengths and whitelist remark use bytes; extension text lengths use Unicode characters. Mail needs enabled SMTP and verified recipient; webhook endpoint needs enabled state and signing secret. Points stay <=9007199254740991. Invite secret is delivered privately, never a receipt. R15 additionally registers level.grant, whitelist.remove and plugin.hook, with fresh site/actor/target/credential ceilings at preparation and transaction/dispatch. No arbitrary script or shell action exists.

rememberDevice.description: Request a separate trusted-device grant after challenge completion; the original challenge remembers the session's remember setting.

OpsContractLoginPolicy.description: Applicable allowed-method lists intersect; required providers union; stricter fresh-factor/session limits win. Empty allowed list inherits; maxSessions=0 unrestricted. Password/code must be enabled; binding providers must permit binding and global allowBind be true. Disjoint effective login-method intersection rejected.

items.description: password, code, passkey or oidc:<enabled-provider-code>; empty inherits.

OpsContractLoginResult.description: Current service.LoginResult. Normal success carries a session JWT. Pending challenge or setup carries its respective object and ordinary session fields retain zero values (empty strings, userId=0, isAdmin=false, expires_at=null); those fields are not omitted. trustedDevice is an optional independent grant after requested challenge completion. Check challenge/setup before persisting access_token. appApproval is another pending continuation; finish its original-browser proof and App approval before treating login as complete.

OpsContractLoginSetupGrant.description: Enrollment-only grant for X-Login-Setup. This is not a session access token; valid only on login-policy setup routes.

OpsContractMFAStatus.description: TOTP enabled state, unused recovery-code count and registered-passkey count. confirmedAt/lastUsedAt omitted when unavailable.

siteId.description: Trusted owning site; client input cannot move this record between sites.

OpsContractNativeEvent.description: Generic webhook codec event; nonempty eventId/kind/userId/chatId required. Decoder fixes platform=webhook and supplies current time if omitted. Raw platform payload is optional and ignored for command authorization.

reply.description: String dictionary; keys are defined by the associated catalog or protocol.

OpsContractOneBot11.description: OneBot 11 event. post_type message/notice/request/meta_event; message may be CQ-code text or segment array. Extra platform event fields are retained only by raw protocol decoding.

data.description: Protocol segment values; OneBot 11 expects strings, OneBot 12 also permits numeric/boolean values.

OpsContractOneBot12.description: OneBot 12 event; time is Unix seconds, possibly fractional.

data.description: Protocol segment values; OneBot 11 expects strings, OneBot 12 also permits numeric/boolean values.

OpsContractPasskeyAssertion.description: WebAuthn PublicKeyCredential assertion. Binary fields are base64url. Usernameless login resolves credential id/userHandle through stored user credentials; library validates challenge, origin, RP id and required user verification.

OpsContractPasskeyAttestation.description: WebAuthn PublicKeyCredential registration result, sent as JSON without an additional wrapper. Binary fields are base64url; response contains attestationObject rather than assertion signature. sessionId/name are query parameters.

OpsContractPasskeyOptions.description: Both WebAuthn begins return {sessionId, options:{publicKey:...}}. Registration uses creation fields (rp,user,pubKeyCredParams); login uses assertion fields (rpId,userVerification). Operations reference their exact variant.

OpsContractPasskeyRequest.description: Discoverable credential assertion options. Pass options.publicKey to navigator.credentials.get after binary conversion; no username is submitted.

extensions.description: Optional WebAuthn extension inputs from the library.

captchaToken.description: Provider widget token; GeeTest v4 uses a JSON-serialized validate payload, other providers opaque token.

bindingLocked.description: When true, binding this actual QQ provider creates a permanent identity binding.

OpsContractRegisterBody.description: Public self-signup requires explicit region. No GeoIP, provider, locale or phone-prefix default is inferred. Legal input is conditional on current site policy.

captchaToken.description: Widget token or GeeTest JSON-serialized validate payload.

inviteCode.description: Validated by installed registration hooks; required when auth.invite_required is enabled.

OpsContractReqNode.description: Maximum depth 8 (root depth 0), total 200 nodes across tree, alt and exemptWhen branches. exemptWhen waives only its owning node when independently known true; unknown evidence never grants an exemption. Groups need children; atLeast needs 1<=n<=children length. Fact/operator/required param must match /requirements/facts; legacy rule strings are validated. Missing evidence cannot make a NOT group eligible.

message.description: Language to text; at most 8 keys, each key <=16 bytes and value <=1000 bytes.

OpsContractRetention.description: null kind inherits default, zero keeps forever. Rollups contain counts, no personal data; at most 90 newest day rows.

OpsContractTOTPRecoveryCodes.description: Eight new plaintext one-time recovery codes, returned only on creation/regeneration. Store separately; later status gives remaining count only.

OpsContractTelemetryReport.description: Empty {} when collection disabled/opted-out/DNT/GPC. Otherwise id (possibly 0 on insert failure), with signed probe URLs only for missing address families.

OpsContractTrustedDeviceGrant.description: Returned once after requested challenge completion when remembered-device issuance succeeds. Send token as X-Trusted-Device on later first-factor logins; it does not authorize account APIs. Configured days=0 disables issuance, default 30 days; newest 10 remembered devices retained.

OpsContractVisit.description: Full current row projection; detail/pDigest/atMs never exposed. telemetry:sensitive controls identifiers/UA/screen/viewport/clientTz/district. Without it identifiers are empty and region reduced to country/province/city. Erased rows set userId=0 and sessionId=''. IPs masked when telemetry.mask_ip and field:ip:sensitive absent. R15 optional page/feature/button fields are client-reported; event/page IDs and hash version remain hidden. New row hashes bind site and optional payload; v0 historical hashes are preserved.

envAt.description: when the browser reported its environment

envCarried.description: environment copied from the session's earlier visit

erased.description: personal fields blanked after the account was deleted

hash.description: chains the row to the previous one

ip.description: the client address the request came from

ipv6.description: both families are filled when the dual-stack probe saw the other one

userId.description: 0 for a failed sign-in to an unknown account

OpsContractVisitAccount.description: Exact lifecycle/account projection: no IP, identifier, fingerprint, risk score, UA, hashes or detail.

OpsContractVisitDetailData.description: The visit's JSON detail (not part of the hash; online lookups complete it later); absent parts are omitted.

probe.description: the other address family seen by the dual-stack probe

request.description: New stored request metadata excludes query, authorization/cookie/proof/client-env headers and uses a finite safe referrer path. Historical rows may retain their old optional query field; permission/IP minimization still applies.

fromReport.description: taken from the browser's report, not the sign-in request

what differs from the account's previous visit

components.description: component (bot, vpn, proxy, tor, datacenter, anomaly, resale) → points

OpsContractWebAuthnExtensions.description: WebAuthn extension outputs. Known standard fields are specified; other registered browser extension results may be present and are processed by the WebAuthn library.

siteId.description: Trusted owning site; client input cannot move this record between sites.

OpsContractWorkflowConfig.description: Trigger manual/schedule/inbound or exact registered domain event from catalog. intervalMinutes required only for schedule. Conditions AND; missing fields fail including ne. Numeric comparisons require numbers; contains requires string.

OpsContractWorkflowSave.description: Trimmed name <=100 bytes; version must match on PUT. Saving an enabled workflow also needs execute permission.

OutboundProxyInput.description: HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5/SOCKS5H URL with an explicit port and no userinfo/path/query. Password omitted retains the saved value; empty clears it. Up to 100 exact hosts or dot-prefixed subdomain suffixes. No direct fallback after a selected proxy fails.

OutboundProxyServerInput.description: Omitted password retains the stored value; empty clears it. Explicit proxy port required. Up to 64 uniquely identified profiles. TLS certificates are always verified.

OwnProfile.description: The owner's view: every stored value, the user's explicit visibility choices (unset = the schema default) and the completion state. Keys match ProfileInput, so the SPA can send it back.

incomplete.description: For pending or forceExisting accounts, true when a built-in or registered module-required field is missing. A module check failure leaves recovery routes accessible and returns false here; explicit completion still fails without clearing pending.

bindingLocked.description: When true, binding this actual QQ provider creates a permanent identity binding.

PublicConfig.description: Current site configuration from Settings.PublicConfig, handler/auth.go and installed public-config hooks. Module properties are present only when their hook is installed; providers use this host's tenant overlay. In install mode the independent install engine returns only its install bootstrap fields. Additional properties remain allowed because third-party module hooks can extend this registry.

additionalProperties.description: Locale code to text; zh_CN, zh_TW, en and ja are recognized.

installRequired.description: install mode only (the instance is not installed yet); the SPA then sends every page to the install wizard

additionalProperties.description: Locale code to text; zh_CN, zh_TW, en and ja are recognized.

eta.description: Configured estimated recovery time, or empty when no estimate was supplied.

message.description: Locale code to text; zh_CN, zh_TW, en and ja are recognized.

mainUrl.description: Configured main frontend URL used to obtain a fresh subsite administration entry; empty when unconfigured.

items.description: Site-scoped user availability, independent of master settings and sidebar visibility. Disabled routes and descendants are denied by the SPA; corresponding user APIs are checked on every request with no administrator bypass. Admin APIs remain separate.

PublicProfile.description: PublicAvatarOf applies current avatar policy without mutating the original stored image or exposing contact-derived avatar URLs. Other fields are present only when both profile schema and caller visibility allow them. Age is omitted when unavailable/hidden; there are no avatar fallbacks.

title.description: Administrator-managed account title; writes trim surrounding whitespace.

builtin.description: fixed token bucket inside the service that runs as well; the stricter one wins

perTarget.description: also counted per e-mail / phone, not only per IP

enforced.description: the router mounts the limiter on these endpoints (pinned by a test against the real router)

value.description: effective allowance per IP and minute (0 = no limit)

trustedProxies.description: false when `server.trustedProxies` is empty: behind a reverse proxy every client then shares one bucket

country.description: ISO alpha-2, for document types valid in any country

region.description: optional issuing region; must match the country

mode.description: review mode of the real-name kind

note.description: optional message to the reviewer, at most 200 characters

items.description: slots that request must upload

provider.description: provider title while a provider checks the record

region.description: issuing region of the latest record; empty = unknown (old record)

verifyMethod.description: empty = old record, reviewed by hand

RecoveryCodes.description: Eight new plaintext one-time recovery codes, returned only on creation/regeneration. Store separately; later status gives remaining count only.

RegisterBody.description: Public self-signup requires explicit region. No GeoIP, provider, locale or phone-prefix default is inferred. Legal input is conditional on current site policy.

captchaToken.description: Widget token or GeeTest JSON-serialized validate payload.

code.description: Required when auth.register_verify_required is enabled; obtained for scene register. Ignored when verification disabled.

inviteCode.description: Validated by installed registration hooks; required when auth.invite_required is enabled.

nickname.description: Trimmed; empty generates localized default nickname.

password.description: Maximum 64 UTF-8 bytes; configurable minimum (default 8), required character classes, no whitespace and optional breach check.

target.description: Email <=128 bytes or mainland China mobile matching ^1[3-9][0-9]{9}$.

callbackHours.description: how long a `pending` answer may wait, 1-720

scope.description: JSON data-scope definition

RoleTemplateContractApply.description: Top-level level/scope/menuIds override template; null/missing uses template. roleId/createTime reset for a new role; role.level/scope ignored in favor of the top-level/template values.

scope.description: Serialized RoleScope JSON: {users:"all"|"level_lte"|"none",maxUserLevel:integer,servers:"all"|int64[],canGrantRoles:int64[]}. Blank means restrictive default. Invalid JSON fails; unknown modes normalize restrictively, IDs deduplicate and trust levels clamp. Applies only to sub-admin level 1.

Invalid JSON fails; unknown modes normalize restrictively, IDs deduplicate and trust levels clamp. Applies only to sub-admin level 1.

RoleTemplateContractInput.description: Create can copy non-super roleId; explicit fields win. Update ignores roleId and absent/null pointer fields keep stored values. Name/description trimmed and clipped to 64/255 runes. Level 2 stays normal; other values become sub-admin 1. menuIds=null preserves/copied selection; [] clears resolved selection. skipped=null retains unresolved refs; [] removes them.

Invalid JSON fails; unknown modes normalize restrictively, IDs deduplicate and trust levels clamp. Applies only to sub-admin level 1.

configError.description: why the page would refuse to load; empty when fine

SdkLoginAudit.description: One `sdk_login_audits` row: a sign-in attempt through a server's login page. `method` is the session login type (password, code, passkey, register, oidc:…); `reason` is a stable token (an OAuth error code, `untrusted_redirect`, `unavailable`, `policy`, `server_error`); `result` is success / denied / failed. Kept as a security audit trail after account deletion.

requireOnline.description: refuse sign-in while the server is offline

redirect_uri.description: one of the server's configured redirect URIs

scope.description: space separated; within the configured scopes

enabled.description: the module is on for this server

allOf.description: Locked cards include only ID, owner site, public name/icon and empty/default values for all private server fields; no address, roles, statistics, descriptions or modules.

ServersContractBan.description: operator/revoker only for administrators; revokeSource/revokeReason omitted when empty. Null expiry is permanent.

ServersContractBanInput.description: Supply at most one nonempty expireTime or nonzero durationMinutes; neither means permanent. Reasons reject control/bidi characters.

expireTime.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or RFC3339, future and no more than 3650 days ahead.

ServersContractConfig.description: Missing keys use defaults; null/unknown/mistyped keys fail. maxServerBytes must be at least maxUserBytes. Quotas count plaintext JSON bytes.

ServersContractData.description: Every currently defined field maps to a valid stored value, otherwise its default, otherwise null. version=0 and updatedAt=null before first write. size is stored plaintext bytes; updatedBy is omitted when unset.

data.description: Keys and JSON value types are defined by the current server field/action schema.

ServersContractDetail.description: dataError replaces data if decrypting/loading player data fails.

code.description: Nonzero business code; inspect each operation description.

ServersContractField.description: Case-insensitive unique keys. Empty label defaults to key. text maxLength is characters (default 255, max 20000); json is compact bytes (default 4096, max 32768). select needs options; numeric min<=max. Irrelevant constraints are removed. Null default is unset; non-null default must validate. No control/bidi characters in labels/options.

ServersContractGMAction.description: At most 200 accepted actions; duplicate/invalid entries are skipped. Empty danger normalizes to normal; unknown danger requires confirmation. Titles/descriptions/categories are trimmed and clipped.

key.description: Plugin key <=64 UTF-8 bytes; no colon, whitespace or controls.

labels.description: Language code to localized action title.

ServersContractGMCatalogAction.description: Effective plugin or registered source action; source key is source:key (not subject to plugin-only no-colon/64-byte limit).

anyOf.description: Language code to title; null when override replaces labels.

ServersContractGMCommand.description: No operatorId on wire. History masks names by caller role; plugin replaces administrator name with staff on owned servers. Execute response uses unmasked command view; mine is present only in owner/grantee histories.

params.description: Keys and JSON value types are defined by the current server field/action schema.

ServersContractGMConfig.description: Strict module config; requireLevel <= current site LevelMax on save. Unknown/null/mistyped values fail. Invalid stored config blocks execution even for admins.

ServersContractGMExecute.description: Exactly one nonempty action/preset. params serialized JSON <=16 KiB, absent/null means {}. With declared parameter schema, unknown keys fail and required/types/constraints apply; legacy no-param actions accept arbitrary JSON objects. confirm=true required for confirm/critical; critical additionally needs confirmText exactly the action key or preset ID after trim.

anyOf.description: Keys and JSON value types are defined by the current server field/action schema.

ServersContractGMFavorites.description: Replaces both lists; deduplicates, maximum 50 combined. Keys checked for 1-100 bytes only, not current existence.

ServersContractGMGrantInput.description: Exact active account username on create (ignored on update); owner already has access and cannot be granted. allActions covers present/future actions, else 1-100 unique keys. minLevel <= site LevelMax. Expiry null/zero means forever, otherwise future. At most 50 grants/server, duplicate account rejected.

ServersContractGMLayout.description: Strict unknown-field rejection, unique widget/preset IDs and <=64 KiB raw and serialized layout. Missing actions can be retained as unavailable references.

ServersContractGMLoginConfig.description: serverId on input is overwritten by path; hidden revision/owner ID never serialized. Enabled URLs must be same-origin HTTPS with no query/fragment/userinfo; local/private IPs rejected in production. Debug mode permits HTTP loopback. Disabled with both URLs empty is allowed. requireLevel <= LevelMax.

ServersContractGMOptions.description: Named plugin option lists (source-pattern keys). Maximum 20 lists, 500 unique options per list; empty list accepted but select accepts no values.

ServersContractGMOverride.description: Override cannot reduce original danger. Hidden action is executable only via a preset. Defaults validate against existing action schema.

defaults.description: Keys and JSON value types are defined by the current server field/action schema.

ServersContractGMPanel.description: config only for admin. Grant-specific access fields only for grantee. Managers see overrides and hidden/unavailable actions; grantees see allowed actions/widgets/runnable presets only.

presetInfo.description: Preset ID to execution availability and effective danger.

ServersContractGMParam.description: Empty type becomes string; unknown legacy type is retained and has no non-string value type enforcement. Text default cap 4000 chars, string/custom strings 1000, player always 64; explicit maxLength bounded to 4000. Number validates min/max/integer; step is UI metadata only. Select uses published named list, else inline options, else string <=128 bytes until list published; source on string/player is suggestions only.

type.description: string/text/number/boolean/select/player; int/integer/float/double/bool/textarea aliases accepted. Custom legacy names retained in lowercase.

ServersContractGMPreset.description: Step value {{name}} substitutes a declared preset parameter; otherwise literal. All steps must be granted/available at execution. Danger is strictest preset or step.

params.description: Keys and JSON value types are defined by the current server field/action schema.

ServersContractGMWidget.description: Builtins catalog/form/history/players/stats/broadcast/result/iframe plus installed source types. iframe HTTPS URL <=512 bytes, no credentials or own-site origin; backend does not proxy embedded pages.

props.description: catalog: group; form: exactly one action/preset; broadcast: action+param; iframe: url; history/players/stats/result: no properties. Registered widget types may accept <=20 properties and <=4096 combined key/value bytes.

ServersContractGameServer.description: model.GameServer JSON fields; zero roleCount/pendingCount/ownerName/ownerUid are omitted. API key hash and heartbeat player list are never serialized.

siteId.description: The server entity's owning site. Creation takes this from request context and ignores a supplied siteId.

ServersContractMeta.description: Only supplied non-null keys change. Empty tags/note clear. Tags collapse whitespace, deduplicate ignoring case; letters/digits/marks/spaces and -.#+:/ only. Notes allow newline/tab but reject other control and bidi characters.

ServersContractMine.description: Only owner-visible fields and own values, no write metadata. A disabled module appears only while a ban is active, with empty fields/data.

data.description: Keys and JSON value types are defined by the current server field/action schema.

ServersContractOwnerApply.description: Trimmed fields, no control/bidi characters; multiline description/whyList allowed. contactEmail optional bare email without display name. Modules must be compiled server modules on owner allow-list.

ServersContractOwnerInfo.description: Replaces basic fields (omitted strings clear except code); contactEmail/whyList omission/null preserves. Code mutable only before first approval. modules changes requested list only while unapproved. Text rules match application.

icon.description: HTTPS URL without credentials or safe /uploads/ path; empty clears.

ServersContractOwnerPlayers.description: Last heartbeat players; no login/internal ID/avatar/staff identity. reported distinguishes no list ever received from an empty list. Optional identity fields omitted when zero/empty.

ServersContractOwnerPolicy.description: maxPerUser=0 unlimited; all review states count. autoApprove reflects effective review mode, not only stored switch. reason omitted when application allowed.

ServersContractOwnerRole.description: No internal user ID or login/contacts; reviewTime omitted if not reviewed.

ServersContractPluginTarget.description: Provide positive public uid, else a role name and/or UUID bound on this server. uid wins. Ambiguous name/UUID is refused for writes.

ServersContractPortal.description: Public server properties plus the authenticated caller's own roles. No owner/reviewer identity or API-key prefix. Active ban forces userIsWhitelisted=false. Audience-denied cards are minimal locked application cards, without address, role data, status metrics or module entry points.

readOnly.description: True for a shared public card owned by another site; role binding and write actions are unavailable on that card.

siteId.description: The server entity's owning site. Creation takes this from request context and ignores a supplied siteId.

ServersContractPortalBind.description: remark wins; reason is fallback when remark is empty. Trimmed role name is 2-24 characters without space/tab/CR/LF (ASCII Minecraft-style 3-16 also accepted). Role IDs are free text; valid UUID-shaped values are normalized, other values retained. requireRoleId makes roleUuid mandatory.

ServersContractRosterRow.description: Owner never receives account/noteBy. Admin receives account only within account scope; otherwise restricted=true. Optional empty note/source/name fields are omitted.

ServersContractStats.description: 24h/7d/30d buckets are 5 minutes/1 hour/6 hours, local midnight aligned. Missing samples yield null online/TPS. Uptime percent counts gaps >5 minutes and begins no earlier than first-ever heartbeat; peakTime omitted without samples.

ServersContractWhitelistPolicy.description: Complete replacement with zero values for omitted fields; labels trim and reject control/bidi characters.

ServersContractWrite.description: version is optional optimistic concurrency control, 0 means no stored row; mismatch is business code 409. Without version a lost write race retries up to 3 times, then business 409. null values unset fields. Undefined keys or wrong types fail. PUT replaces all values, PATCH merges and null deletes.

headerMapping.description: JSON text mapping safe response headers to this app's published claim aliases. Maximum 12 unique case-insensitive names, 64 bytes each, remote-/x-sso- prefix or x-lounge-uid. Empty inherits sso.default_headers and then built-in mapping, omitting claims this app does not release.

ipAllowlist.description: Delimited CIDR prefixes; empty allows any IP.

SsoContractAppInput.description: Full replacement. Text limits in validateApp are UTF-8 byte limits. HTTPS launch/icon/callback URLs forbid user info and fragments. oidc needs unique registered clientId. forward-auth host must equal launch URL host; default pathPrefix=/, no .. or ?/#/backslash. ticket needs HTTPS callback. cas needs one unique exact HTTPS service callback, <=2048 bytes and no ticket query. superOnly changes require a super administrator. R14 fields add ticket logout callbacks, claim aliases and absolute app session lifetime; omitted fields are zero/empty on full replacement. OIDC mapping is applied after scope/privacy/delivery release and cannot replace sub or increase claims.

claimMapping.description: JSON text: output alias -> existing uid/username/name/email/groups field. Maximum 16 aliases; empty uses canonical fields. Names are 1..64 ASCII identifier characters, no xml prefix or protocol-reserved claims. Explicit {} releases none.

sessionLifetimeSeconds.description: 0 inherits the parent account session. Otherwise an absolute limit from original login, never extended by a renewed browser grant or RP refresh.

SsoContractCasResponse.description: CAS 2/3 XML serviceResponse in http://www.yale.edu/tp/cas. Success contains cas:authenticationSuccess/cas:user (username). CAS3 adds authenticationDate (RFC3339), isFromNewLogin and sessionExpiresAt (Unix seconds), plus configured aliases; default mapping uses uid/displayName/verified email and repeated groups. Failure is cas:authenticationFailure with INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_TICKET, INVALID_SERVICE or INTERNAL_ERROR. Protocol success and failure both use HTTP 200.

SsoContractIdentity.description: uid is decimal public UID; email is empty unless verified; groups is comma-separated role codes.

SsoContractLogoutConfig.description: Callback URLs empty or public HTTPS, <=2048 bytes, without userinfo/fragments/iss/sid query. Server always supplies sid. Existing endpoint change cancels old deliveries instead of sending to the new endpoint.

SsoContractLogoutEvent.description: cancelReason omitted unless permanently cancelled. Session ids, user ids, issuer and endpoint snapshots are excluded. Pending backchannel delivery uses bounded retries (at most 8 attempts). appId is present for ticket-app logout participation. No target SID, user/session identity, callback snapshot or token is exposed.

id_token_hint.description: Signed ID token with issuer/audience/subject/sid binding; expired ID tokens accepted, access/logout tokens rejected.

SsoContractTicketInput.description: signature = hex(HMAC-SHA256(app secret, decimal appId + '\n' + decimal timestamp + '\n' + ticket)). Timestamp may be 60 seconds old or 10 seconds ahead. App secret is not a site token.

SsoContractTicketResult.description: Direct protocol JSON. authTime and expiresAt are Unix seconds. sessionId is an opaque target-session SID, never an account credential. RP must enforce expiresAt and validate issuer/audience; logoutSupported signals durable callback participation for this redemption.

claims.description: App-published identity aliases; values are strings. Verified email only; groups are comma-separated role codes.

info.description:
SPA account and administration endpoints generally answer HTTP 200 with the envelope `{code, message, data}`; `code` 0 means success, 400 bad parameters, 401 login required, 403 forbidden, anything else a business error. Paged endpoints put `{list, count}` in `data`; nil data is omitted. Protocol callbacks, SCIM, native endpoints and file streams use the media types and HTTP statuses stated in their individual contracts. Messages are localised by `?lang=`, `X-Lang` or `Accept-Language`.

The OpenID Provider endpoints under `/oauth2/*`, `/.well-known/*` and `/jwks.json` follow the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC wire formats instead (plain JSON bodies, RFC 6749 error objects, real HTTP status codes).

Shared API deployment: browser requests to the configured server.baseUrl host under /api select the site from a registered Origin (or a matching site_origin query on read-only navigations). CORS returns the exact allowed origin, credentials and exposed Authorization. Origin only selects a tenant: tokens and sessions must still belong to it. Unregistered origins cannot fall back to the main site. OAuth protocol endpoints do not interpret a relying-party Origin as a frontend site. See docs/SUBSITES.md.

Rate-limited entry points (`/api/login`, `/api/login/code`, `/api/verify/send`, `/api/register`, `/api/password/reset`, `/api/account/unlock`, `/oauth2/token`) answer HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` when the per-IP allowance in settings is exceeded.

Feature modules (`internal/modules/*`, `docs/MODULES.md`) mount their routes under the same groups; their operations are tagged `modules/<name>`. Button permissions and the default auth of every operation are read from the route middleware. Gin `Any` registrations are expanded into the eight standard OpenAPI HTTP methods; their CONNECT handler is preserved as the Path Item `x-connect` extension with `x-http-method: CONNECT`.

Generated by `Backend/scripts/gen_openapi.py` from `internal/router/router.go`, `internal/router/routes_*.go` and `internal/modules/**`, plus the install-mode engine in `internal/install` (routes collected by `openapi_routes.py`); exercised end-to-end by `Backend/scripts/smoke.sh` / `smoke.ps1`.

put.description: Native credential alternative requires native.account.write, a live exact App/device/family and signed native proof; it carries no administrator authority. Current App admission, bans, policy and account gates still apply. A separately approved brs_ read/write browser delegation requires its matching cookie and live originating family, without native-device proof headers. Credential admission errors remain 401/403/409/429 API-envelope codes, not successful business execution.
